description: This file defines the implementation of a server loop component for the 'cuttlefish' project, utilizing the Fruit dependency injection framework. It includes header files, declares a destructor, and provides a function to create and configure a dependency injection component with bindings and multibindings for the server loop.

classes.name: ServerLoop
classes.description: Abstract class representing the server loop, with a virtual destructor.

classes.name: ServerLoopImpl
classes.description: Implementation class of the ServerLoop, used in dependency injection bindings.

methods.name: serverLoopComponent
methods.description: Creates and configures a dependency injection component for the server loop, binding the ServerLoop interface to its implementation and adding multibindings for late-injected and setup features.
